About

I'm a graduate researcher and engineer at the University of Wisconsin–Madison, specializing in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and NLP. My research spans 3D Image editing with Diffusion Models, Vision Language Models and training distributed LLM.

Previously, I spent three years as a software engineer in Addis Ababa building scalable backend systems, and I interned at Amazon Seattle in summer 2025 on the Alexa team.

Outside of research, I mentor emerging engineers as part of Black in AI, advocating for representation and inclusion across the field.
